title: renode-firmware.yml create-beads-on-failure never persists the bead (ephemeral checkout, no push)
description: Codereview pass-3 observation on yc6p (pre-existing): .github/workflows/renode-firmware.yml:196-210 'create-beads-on-failure' runs bd create against the ephemeral runner checkout's .beads/ but never commits or pushes — the failure bead is lost when the runner exits, so the job's stated purpose silently no-ops. continue-on-error: true additionally masks bd possibly being absent on the runner. Either persist (commit .beads and push, needs contents:write scoped to that job) or replace with gh issue create / workflow annotation. Note: yc6p added top-level permissions: contents:read, so persisting via git push would now also require a job-level permissions override.
